title: Password Policy
description: Manage password complexity, expiration and history restrictions

enabled.label: Enable Password Policy
enabled.desc: When enabled, user passwords must meet the current policy requirements.

maxLength.label: Maximum Length
maxLength.desc: Control the maximum allowed characters for passwords.

requireUppercase.label: Require Uppercase
requireUppercase.desc: At least one uppercase letter required.

requireLowercase.label: Require Lowercase
requireLowercase.desc: At least one lowercase letter required.

requireSpecialChar.label: Require Special Character
requireSpecialChar.desc: At least one special character required.

specialChars.label: Special Characters
specialChars.desc: Define the allowed special character set.

rotationDays.label: Rotation Period
rotationDays.desc: Takes effect on each user's next login. Set to 0 to stop limiting password validity.

historyCount.label: History Count
historyCount.desc: Limit the last N passwords from being reused. Set to 0 for no restriction.

validation.lengthRange: Minimum length cannot be greater than maximum length

expireWarnDays.label: Expiry Reminder Days
expireWarnDays.desc: When the remaining days are within this value, a password expiry notice is shown at login and in the profile center.
